units.source_text: 像末摘花和空蝉那样受源氏荫庇的女人甚多。

en.t: There were many women, like Suetsumuhana and Utsusemi, who lived under Genji's protection.

units.source_text: 源氏一一前往探望，亲切地对她们说这样的话：

en.t: Genji went to visit each of them in turn and spoke to them kindly in words such as these:

units.source_text: “许久不曾会晤，心中无时或忌。

en.t: It has been a long time since we last met, yet there has not been a moment when I was not thinking of you.

units.source_text: 所可虑者，只是人寿有限，聚散无常耳。

en.t: What troubles me is only that human life is limited, and meetings and partings are uncertain.
One truly cannot know what fate has in store!

units.source_text: 他觉得每一个女人，各有其可爱之处。

en.t: He felt that every woman had her own lovable qualities.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣身居一人之下，万人之上，然而绝不盛气凌人。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, stood below only one person and above all others, yet he never behaved arrogantly toward anyone.

units.source_text: 其待人接物，均按照地点与身份，普施恩惠。

en.t: In dealing with people and affairs, he showed kindness widely, always according to the place and the person's rank.

units.source_text: 许多女人就仰仗着他的好意，悠游度日。

en.t: Many women relied on his goodwill and passed their days in ease.
